title: Custom-modulus Haar normalization uses the wrong field
detail: haar line 26 calls root_half_mod() with its default modulus even when haar(...,p=other) was requested. Pass p through, require an actual square root of 1/2 in that field and test 2*scale^2=1. Default real audits do not cover this path.

title: Green sum custom modulus is not propagated into either solve
detail: sum_green_matrix lines 29-30 omit p=p and only reduce completed default-field answers modulo p at line 31. Reducing a residue representative from one field is not a field homomorphism to another. Bind both solves to the requested p and add nondefault-prime residual tests.

title: Optimized Python removes most certificate checks
detail: Many routines assert equality/structure and then return unconditional True or proof-like labels. With -O/PYTHONOPTIMIZE those checks vanish. Use explicit checked rejection for acceptance-critical gates and make returned evidence reflect performed checks. spectral_certificate is a positive exception: its nonpositive-pivot/inexact-division raises are explicit.

title: Exact dependencies are located but runtime closure is not certified
detail: Dependency hashes and local paths are bound in DEPENDENCY_IDENTITY.json. unitary_mixer.py, haar_adapter_mod.py and the Phase11 unittest file are outside assigned source-read scope. Bare imports/sys.path/sys.modules and unpinned interpreter, NumPy, SciPy/BLAS affect reproducibility. No unreviewed dependency receives coverage credit.

title: Fourier-root and stage contract exceed validated domain
detail: The power-of-two predicate permits N beyond the 2-adic order of 998244353-1, while root exponents use floor division. Stage shape/base-field provenance, col nonconstant residue and mask dimensions are incompletely guarded; zip can silently truncate. Enforce N|(MOD-1), dimensions and the stated algebraic lift assumptions.

title: Permutation, field and pivot assumptions are not uniformly enforced
detail: Public helpers accept some out-of-domain sizes, nonbijective orders/sets, composite moduli or zero-pivot cases. Concrete examples: N=8,B=2 breaks the loosely guarded conductor count; p=3,N=2 gives nonsingular tridiagonal T but no-pivot Thomas fails; spectral run(1) would report a nonexistent lambda2. These do not establish failure of the default finite sample sets.

title: Floating spectral/rank/condition reports are not exact certificates
detail: No directed error bounds, interval enclosure or robust finite-result validation are supplied. Laplacian and SVD thresholds are approximate. np.allclose in condition_audit also inherits default rtol, so its written atol is not the whole tolerance. Preserve numerical-sanity status rather than treating these outputs as all-N proof.

title: Grid audit has vacuous small-size checks and an overbroad success label
detail: For default L=4 and 8, required singular count L//15 equals zero. meets_theorem=True is returned after five sampled cut checks, without checking all theorem statements or the reported condition number. Strengthen expectations where meaningful and label sampled numeric conclusions precisely.

title: No faster Fourier algorithm or global review completion follows
detail: The sources are finite audits, restricted algebraic obstructions, positive small Fourier controls and O(N) non-Fourier stages. Dense rank, matrix construction, exact determinants, full-basis and subset enumeration costs must be charged separately. Field-operation bounds are not unqualified bit bounds. Source inspection completion is not test execution, theorem acceptance or dependency-closure completion.

title: Certificates and pipeline outputs are not self-contained acceptance artifacts
detail: Shell > redirects truncate destination results before children finish; failures may leave incomplete JSON. The spectral pivot digest commits only the pivot list, not graph/order/source/environment and omits the full sequence. Exact gap generation is logically sound on valid inputs, but artifact replay/acceptance requires those identities and a verifier or full replay.

title: Three-stage probe hardcodes exact_fourier=False
detail: candidate_rank_gates line 56 returns False independently of covariance/Galois ranks. For current sampled rejected candidates it is consistent, but the API should derive a rejection flag from a nonzero necessary defect and otherwise report undecided or perform direct equality. Zero defects alone cannot certify Fourier equality.

title: Finite examples, shared primitives and external proofs remain distinct
detail: All test results discussed here are source-encoded intended checks, not observations from this review. Many dense/fast comparisons share tridiagonal/rank helpers. Modular nonzero witnesses can refute a compatible characteristic-zero identity; modular equality at one prime cannot prove it universally. All-order proofs referenced in documentation were not re-certified by this source-only task.

title: Direct unittest entry points skip later concrete-Green test classes
detail: test_halfcut.py calls unittest.main at 48-49 before ExactGreenHalfcutTest at 51-56; test_minor_gate.py calls it at 52-53 before SuppliedGreenFamilyTest at 55-60. Move each main block after all classes. Import-based discovery includes the classes, so the defect must not be misreported as a discovery failure.
